r01.binding_paraphrase: indulgence given so much latitude that it runs to collapse
r01.liberating_paraphrase: disciplined restraint that keeps its form and contains the collapsing tendency

r02.binding_paraphrase: an inflated sense of sole doership — the swollen self claiming all agency
r02.liberating_paraphrase: acting effectively without claiming sole doership

r03.binding_paraphrase: a spellbound daze in which judgment is suspended under an overpowering fixation
r03.liberating_paraphrase: the daze broken into clear sense — the mind drawn back onto a steady path

r04.binding_paraphrase: the sting of resentment at another's good fortune
r04.liberating_paraphrase: warm fellow-feeling that welcomes another's good fortune

r05.binding_paraphrase: a rigid over-holding — clinging to what one has, resisting movement toward the subtle
r05.liberating_paraphrase: resting firmly in one's true stance — a sustaining steadiness that keeps moving toward the subtle

r06.binding_paraphrase: harshness that harms the weak — crude, cruel thought and conduct
r06.liberating_paraphrase: protective kindness toward the vulnerable — the will to reduce another's hardship

r07.binding_paraphrase: wavering self-doubt that cannot commit — distrust of oneself and others
r07.liberating_paraphrase: steady self-reliance — the confidence to commit and to trust

r08.binding_paraphrase: reactive irritability — contrary offence taken and discharged at others
r08.liberating_paraphrase: an even temper that absorbs provocation without discharging it

r09.binding_paraphrase: restless striving that cannot stop — effort compulsively driven outward
r09.liberating_paraphrase: purposeful effort that acts and then settles into alert repose

r10.binding_paraphrase: a pull toward physical wanting — grasping for possessions, status, and renown
r10.liberating_paraphrase: physical wanting redirected upward, its grip on worldly objects released

r11.binding_paraphrase: disregard for what genuinely matters — real worth left unattended through misplaced indifference
r11.liberating_paraphrase: attentive regard that recognizes and honors genuine worth

r12.binding_paraphrase: possessive mine-ness bounded to one's own — clinging to what is one's own while excluding the rest
r12.liberating_paraphrase: affection widened past its own boundaries into open-handed, universal care

r13.binding_paraphrase: uneasy churning over unresolved what-ifs and personal consequences
r13.liberating_paraphrase: composed, impersonal reflection that holds a situation open without forcing an end

r14.binding_paraphrase: clarity or purity clung to as superiority — a subtle attachment to one's own attainment
r14.liberating_paraphrase: clear, unattached openness — clarity held without clinging to it

r15.binding_paraphrase: fixation on the outward, visible surface of things
r15.liberating_paraphrase: an inner, subtle seeing that looks past the surface

r16.binding_paraphrase: clinging hope fixed on a particular outcome — a downward pull of attached wanting
r16.liberating_paraphrase: forward hope held loosely — acting while releasing the grip on the result

r17.binding_paraphrase: possessive acquisition — pursuing and gripping worldly aims as status or control
r17.liberating_paraphrase: purposeful action pursued without possessive clinging
